name: Joseph Mawulorm Mensah
short_bio: Petroleum engineer (BSc, KNUST) completing an MPhil in Chemical Engineering. Works on renewable energy systems, biodiesel and biogas R&D, and AI-driven data modelling for internationally funded energy projects.
bio: Analytical engineer and researcher working across renewable energy systems, process modelling, AI and backend software. Joseph has contributed to internationally funded energy and sustainability projects, including Ghana GOALS and Trans-Sahara Living Labs, and leads modelling of catalytic biodiesel production at KNUST.
expertise: Multiphysics & process simulation, solar mini-grids, biogas, machine learning

name: Ephraim Abotsi
short_bio: Computer scientist (BSc, First-class Honours, KNUST) pursuing an MPhil in Computer Science. AWS Certified Solutions Architect working on cloud infrastructure, networking, security and machine-learning applications.
bio: Computer scientist with a First-class degree from KNUST and a background in Python, networking, security and cloud computing. Ephraim builds cloud infrastructure and machine-learning tools, including a real-time detector for mobile-money fraud messages, and brings teaching experience supporting 40+ final-year projects.
expertise: AWS architecture, networking, security, Python & data analysis
